Class SimulatorController

java.lang.Object
pt.ipp.isep.dei.controller.SimulatorController
public class SimulatorController extends Object
Controller that links together the map, simulation clock, and scenario management, coordinating simulation updates and scenario application during the simulation lifecycle.
